pr_title: Avoid loading files for cached format results
pr_body:
## Summary

Avoid loading the content of cached files during formatting

## Test Plan

Closes #8132

## Performance

This reduces the runtime for a hot formatting on airflow from ~105ms to ~90ms

Thanks @konstin for the find.

issue_context.title: Don't read source files in formatter when there is a cache hit
issue_context.body: Currently, we always read source files in formatter even when we hit the cache. With a hacky change, not reading source files is 10% faster with a hot cache. The task is to refactor the formatter result types so that we don't read the source files if we hit the cache and don't need them.

review_comments: This was easier than i expected
